notes.title: Hunteroids is now available!
notes.content:
Hi there!

I am really glad to announce Hunteroids has been released!

Remember all you have available in the first version:

[list]
[*] Campaign Mode: 8 cities to save (+40 levels), including leaderboards and Steam achievements
[*] Survival Mode: Hunter the maximum number of meteorites in the shortest time possible and be part of the top10
[*] Challenges: Do you want more? You have 3 type of challenges: life, bubbles and time, including Steam leaderboards (12 challenges in total)
[/list]

It has been ~1.5 years, learning as I went through all the challenges.
Exciting period that brings me finally here, today, finalizing a personal project I promised myself to finish.
I am always trying to find ways to improve and explore new things. Let's keep this mind always, no matter what.

I really hope you enjoy!

Cheers!

notes.title: Release date of Hunteroids!
notes.content:
Hi all!

After one year and a half, I am so happy to announce that Hunteroids will be released on [b]September 6th at 19h00 CEST[/b]!

It has been an exciting learning period but I feel it is time to close what we started some time ago.
The game will finally include:

[list]
[*] Campaign mode with 8 cities & +40 levels.
[*] Different challenges (life, time, bubbles), 12 levels.
[*] Survival mode where you will have to hunter as many meteorites as possible.
[*] Steam leaderships for all modes.
[*] Steam achievements.
[/list]

I really hope you enjoy the game! See you soon!

Cheers!

notes.title: Where am I? What remains? Expected Delivery Date?
notes.content:
Hi all!

It has been a long time since the last time I posted so I would like to bring you some updates:

[list]
[*] The [b]Campaign[/b] mode is ready: [b]8 cities[/b] and [b]40+ levels[/b] to enjoy. Each city will bring new mechanics.
[*] The [b]Challenges[/b] are finished: [b]12 levels[/b] from [b]3 different cities[/b].
[*] The [b]Survival[/b] mode is being reviewed, trying to improve the gameplay.
[*] General review of the game & polish, localization, thresholds, trailer, promotional pictures, ...
[/list]

This is the last part of the game but still, I want to spend some time consolidating everything and ensuring I can bring you the best I can do. Because of this, I am expecting to tentatively release the game in Q3, most probably in [b]September[/b], after Summer holidays.

See you soon over here!
Cheers!

notes.title: New Demo available!
notes.content:
Hi there!

As you may know, after the Steam Fest Next, I wanted to simplify the Demo to help players to enjoy the basic mechanics instead of making it that complicated so eventually nobody enjoys.

I have been working on a Demo for already a month that I believe it's more fun, by following the premises above.

In short, this new Demo contains:

[list]
[*] 3 basic cities with 9 levels + 3 improved tutorials explaining the basis
[*] English/Spanish support
[*] Gamepad support
[*] Better GUI
[*] Local Scores (Stars, Life, Bubbles, Time)
[*] No Challenges mode (for final version)
[*] No Survival mode, same as Challenges
[*] No Online Leaderboards (for final version)
[*] No Achievements, same as leadership boards
[/list]

Give a try and let me know your thoughts!

Cheers!

notes.title: Next Steps after Steam Next Fest in October
notes.content:
Hi there!

I would like to share with you the next steps of the development: what I am doing now & what I will do for the final release.

The last Steam Next Fest helped me out to define how I can proceed and here you the main takeaways:

[list]
[*] The tutorial must improve
[*] Limit as much as possible the scope of the Demo. No rankings, no achievements, no challenges, no survival
[*] Reduce the difficulty of the Demo
[*] Final version: Reduce the scope, no Early Access, release in Q1,2023 if possible
[/list]

Based on that, what I am doing now? Basically, I am fully working on a new version of the Demo:

[list]
[*] Only focused on showing how the basic mechanics work: Bring a clear & well-defined tutorial in several levels so the player will enjoy the game.
[*] Limit the scope & reduce the difficulty: no need to have rankings, achievements or challenges/survival modes. They will come with the full version.
[/list]

It will take few weeks until I have the new Demo fully available but I hope this will make the players enjoy the few levels included, avoiding frustration or boredom.

Cheers!

notes.title: Hunteroids Demo launched!
notes.content:
Hi there!

After 6 months intensively working on Hunteroids, I can proudly say I have a demo to share with all of you.
The journey is being challenging, like any other learning process, but also quite fun.
Will you save the city & get the 3 stars? Give a try & tell me how it was!

The scope of the demo is simple:
[list]
[*] 1 tutorial city of 4 levels where I hope you will learn the basis.
[*] 1 city of 5 levels to put everything you learnt in practice. Here, you will have online & personal rankings.
[*] 4 challenges, in case you get 3 stars in the city above. The challenges will be based on life, time, bubbles or everything at the same time.
[/list]

I really hope you enjoy the demo and have some fun! Please, share your thoughts, questions and concerns in the forum. That will help me to learn, fix and define the next steps accordingly.

This demo should be just a small piece of what will finally come. The scope and final version will depend on how the demo goes.
In any case, I will for sure release a full version based on your feedback and lessons learnt from the experience.

Thanks in advance for playing and see you over here!

Cheers!

notes.title: Demo & Testing Version!
notes.content:
Hi there!

As you may know, I am fully working on the Demo that I expect to release by end of the month just to be ready for the next Steam Festival in October.

However, there is a first testing version available, which still has some fixes to work on.

If you have not been chosen yet, be patient, please! I am adding more people gradually, as I test and fix issues. In case you are not eventually chosen, no worries! The Demo will be available quite soon! And everything I am working now will help your first experience. This will be my first priority.

For those that got the approval to get the testing version, I would like to advise you that:

[list]
[*] There is 1 city available (campaign) with 5 levels and 4 challenges to unblock!
[*] In the campaign, if you get 3 stars in any of the following categories (life, bubbles, time or all), a new challenge will be available for you!
[*] If you get 3 stars in all the categories in the campaign, you will unblock one Steam Achievement!
[*] If you get 3 stars in the four challenges available, you will unblock one Steam Achievement!
[*] There will be an online leaderboard where you will register your best record! Will you be in the top 1?
[*] This is a testing version so there could be bugs that I will be fixing in the coming weeks to have the final demo. Any feedback is so appreciated!
[*] As this is a testing version, all achievements or records got in this version will not be taken into account for the demo. In any case, you will get the experience to become the best there!
[*] For any comment or feedback, please go to this thread in the forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1972300/discussions/0/3472855915030759249/
[/list]

Greetings!

notes.title: Current Status of the Demo
notes.content:
Hi there!

Few days ago, I confirmed Hunteroids will be part of the Steam Next Fest in October.

In order to be ready, I have been working hard on the Demo and the progress is quite positive!

In short, the major part of the work is already done and I would like to have the first version of the Demo available in Steam in a few weeks for internal testing. Basically, I still need to test everything in general, adjust the difficulty so the game can be more attractive and polish the interface.

More in detailed, here you have the progress so far!

[list]
[*] City of 5 levels with the basic mechanics completed.
[*] I have included the following in the City: Star-based rating for 4 different categories (life, bubbles, time & general), 1 Steam Achievement if 3 stars in general category and online leaderboards.
[*] 4 challenges that will be unblocked if 3 stars are reached in the City for any of the categories mentioned above. Online leaderboards, Star-based rating & 1 Steam Achievement (if 3 stars in all challenges) are also included.
[*] Gamepad Support, making main controllers configurable via the GUI. Surely, the most difficult part as I had to learn new things so I was not sure if I would be able to make it. Luckily, it is now finished although there are few things to polish.
[*] General configuration: language, volumes and SFX.
[/list]

And, what remains? Well, the list is now limited if we are talking about the first version!

[list]
[*] Adjust the difficulty of the game
[*] Polish the interface for different gamepads (icons, ...)
[*] Testing in general and minor polish
[*] In terms of marketing: update the trailer, update Demo Steam page & upload the Demo to Steam
[/list]

If you have any further question, don't hesitate to pass by the forum so we can talk there!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1972300/discussions/0/3472855915030759249/
